history.summary: The Devka Sun Temple, dedicated to Surya, was built in the 12th or 13th century and is noted for its carved stone architecture. Two smaller ruined temples with stone Ganesha sculptures stand nearby; one source notes inscriptions on columns dated Vikram Samvat 1631 and 1674. COORDINATE FLAG: 26.35284, 71.21238 is the geocoded Devka village point - a maps listing places the temple itself at 26.347515, 71.213611 (verify).

name: Devka Sun Temple
town_description: Devka is a small hamlet about 62 km from Barmer along the Barmer-Jaisalmer Road (NH-15), roughly 12 km north of Sheo town, set amid the Thar Desert landscape.

travel.road: On the Barmer-Jaisalmer Road (NH-15); reachable by taxi or local transport from Barmer (62 km).

visitor_information.opening_hours: 6:00 AM - 6:00 PM daily (travelsetu listing - verify); entry free.
